# from template(rondo, @shanty_drunken_sailor, refrain=bach_prelude_c, episodes=<[c4 e4 g4 c5] [b3 d4 g4 b4]>): a rondo at 116 in C, the phrase sung in it (templates v1)
# phrase: @shanty_drunken_sailor, "What shall we do with a drunken sailor? / Way-ay and up she rises" (Drunken Sailor (No. 7, 'Capstan Chanteys'), sung by Mr. James Tucker at Bristol, Anonymous (traditional), 1914)
# vocal: 17 syllables, free, straight feel, stress x~~x~~x~x~x~~x~x~: a vocal line of 4 bars, sung over sections of 8 bars
# refrain: bach_prelude_c; the tune that comes back, changed on each return
# episodes: <[c4 e4 g4 c5] [b3 d4 g4 b4]>; what plays between the refrains: a line, the episodes' figure, or sections: a seed's, a stored program's, another form's
tempo 116
key c
swing 0.18

# the drums: the drm_* parts are what the arrangement changes; the kick and the shaker stay put
let kick4 = x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let drm_snr = ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let drm_hat = ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x x
let shk = x ~ x x ~ x x ~
# refrain, bound: bach_prelude_c
let tune_1 = c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5 c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5
let tune_2 = c4 d4 a4 d5 f5 a4 d5 f5 c4 d4 a4 d5 f5 a4 d5 f5
let tune_3 = b3 d4 g4 d5 f5 g4 d5 f5 b3 d4 g4 d5 f5 g4 d5 f5
let tune_4 = c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5 c4 e4 g4 c5 e5 g4 c5 e5
let tune = <tune_1 tune_2 tune_3 tune_4>
# episodes, bound: <[c4 e4 g4 c5] [b3 d4 g4 b4]>
let figure_1 = c4 e4 g4 c5
let figure_2 = b3 d4 g4 b4
let figure = <figure_1 figure_2>
# the stride: the bass on the beat, the chord after it
let bass_c = c2 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ g1 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
let bass_g = g1 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
let stride_c = ~ ~ ~ ~ [e3, g3, c4] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [e3, g3, c4] ~ ~ ~
let stride_g = ~ ~ ~ ~ [f3, g3, b3] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [f3, g3, b3] ~ ~ ~
# the vocal line: a degree of the key for each syllable, ! on the stressed ones
let vox_a = 1! 2 4 ~ 3! 4 2 ~
let vox_b = 5! 6 8! 6 5! 4 2 ~
let vox_c = 3! 2 1! 1 ~ ~ ~ ~

# refrain (A): the tune that comes back
section refrain 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=80..95 | clap drm_snr kit=drums vel=60..80 | hihat drm_hat kit=drums vel=40..65 | bass <bass_c bass_g> inst=bass vel=70..85
  deck B: harmony <stride_c stride_g> inst=piano vel=50..65 | melody tune inst=piano vel=55..75
}

# episode (B): something else between the refrains
section episode 8 bars {
  master: reverb 0.15
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=75..90 | hihat drm_hat kit=drums vel=35..55
  deck B: arp figure inst=harpsichord vel=45..65
}

# sung (C): the phrase, the episode's figure under it
section sung 8 bars {
  master: reverb 0.15
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=75..90 | hihat shk kit=drums vel=30..45 | bass <bass_c bass_g> inst=bass vel=65..80
  deck B: arp figure inst=electric-piano vel=25..40 | melody <vox_a vox_b vox_c ~> inst=kalimba oct=3 vel=24..38
  deck B: sing "what /sh ae l/ we do with a /d r uh ng k uh n - s ay l er/ / way /ay/ and up she /r ie z ii z/" on melody voice=robot-choir
}

# A B A C A ...: the refrain mutated on each return, the episodes between
arrange {
  refrain
  episode
  ~ tune_* rot 2 | accent 0.3
  refrain
  sung
  @ tune_* mirror | vel 2
  refrain
  ~ figure_* morph tune_1 0.2
  episode
  ~ tune_* up 1
  refrain
  @ vox_* xfer shk
  sung
  ~ tune_* down 1
  refrain
} loop 2 then end
